name: Buenos Aires
about: Southern Hemisphere seasons; spring (Sep–Nov) and fall (Mar–May) are mild and ideal, summer is hot and humid.
overview: European-flavored boulevards, world-class steak, and tango born in the working-class barrios south of downtown.
costOverview: Genuinely one of the best-value major capitals for food and wine — a proper steak dinner costs a fraction of what it would in North America or Europe.
